transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble lately. I keep... getting hit out of nowhere with this scene. Of my cousin on the pavement. It's... it's like I can hear the shouting and see the lights again. Even when I'm just standing in the church office, you know, trying to act normal. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do these scenes of your cousin on the pavement feel like they're happening all over again, right now, when they come to you?

Yeah... I guess so. It's... like I said, it's like I can hear the shouting all over again. The lights are right there. So... yeah. It feels like I'm right back on that pavement, even when I know I'm just standing in the office.
How long do these scenes of your cousin on the pavement last when they happen to you?
I don't know... I haven't really timed them. It just... it feels like a while. Then it's over, and I'm just standing there.
Is there something specific that usually happens right before these scenes of your cousin on the pavement appear to you?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I haven't really noticed a pattern or anything like that. It just... it just kind of happens.
Do you find yourself trying to avoid people, places, or things that remind you of what happened to your cousin?

Yeah... I guess so. I just... I take the long way around town now. Just so I don't have to pass the community center... or that court. And if somebody starts talking about that night, I just... I shut it down. Or I find a reason to leave.
Do you feel guilty or to blame in any way for what happened to your cousin?

I mean... yeah. I guess I do. It's just... I keep thinking about it. If I had just ended the event earlier... or walked him out... or, I don't know, just kept a better eye on those boys. If I had just done something different, he'd still be here.
Do you have trouble sleeping at night?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I sleep okay, I guess. It's fine.
Do you find yourself constantly on the lookout for potential dangers or threats, even when you're in a safe environment?

I guess... yeah. I just... I don't like sitting with my back to a door anymore. And... when we have events at the church, I'm just... I find myself watching people's hands, or looking at corners... checking if cars are slowing down outside. I just... I'm always looking for the nearest exit, instead of really paying attention to the people I'm supposed to be talking to.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy doing?

Yeah... I guess. I just... I don't know. 

Things I used to love doing... preaching, playing keys... taking pictures, running on the court with the guys. I just... I mostly just go through the motions now. Or I just avoid it altogether. It just doesn't... none of it really feels alive in me anymore.
Do you ever find that you can't remember important parts of what happened to your cousin, even when you try to think about it?
No... not really. I remember it. I don't think I've forgotten any of it.
How often do you find yourself avoiding things that remind you of your cousin's incident?

I guess... a lot. I just... I don't go near the community center anymore. Or the court. I take the long way around town so I don't have to see it. And... if someone brings up that night, I just... I shut it down. Or I just walk away. I don't want to talk about it.
Have you avoided any social activities or relationships because of what happened to your cousin?
No, I don't think so. I just... I still see people. I just don't want to talk about that night.
How long have you been experiencing these scenes of your cousin on the pavement?
Since... since it happened. It's been two years and three months... since he was killed.
Have you stopped doing things you used to enjoy because they remind you of your cousin?

Yeah... I guess. I used to... I used to love preaching. Playing the keys. Taking pictures... running with the guys on the court. But now... I don't know. I mostly just go through the motions. Or I just avoid it altogether. It just... none of it really feels alive in me anymore.
Have you avoided intimacy or close relationships with others since your cousin's incident?

I don't... I don't really know. I guess I just feel far away from everyone now. Even when I'm surrounded by people at church... you know, them calling me 'brother', asking me to pray... I just feel like I'm behind glass. Like nobody can really reach me.
Are there any activities that you used to find meaningful or enjoyable that you have completely stopped doing since your cousin's incident?
I... didn't I just mention that? The preaching, and... playing the keys. I just don't really do them anymore. Like I said. I don't... I don't think there's anything else.
Do you feel like you're able to experience a full range of emotions, like happiness or love, like you used to before your cousin's incident?
I don't really know. I guess... I guess I still feel things. I haven't really thought about it much.
Do you feel like you're able to feel as much joy or happiness as you used to before your cousin's incident?
I... I don't really know. Like I just said, I haven't really thought about it. I guess I just... I don't really keep track of things like that right now.
